THE SAMPLE STARLIGHT HARVEST RULES, 2099
1. Short title.—These rules may be called the Sample Starlight Harvest Rules, 2099.
2. Prior approval.—No person shall harvest starlight crystals from a protected grove without prior approval of the fictional Grove Authority.
3. Benefit sharing.—A person who harvests starlight crystals shall share one tenth of the sea shells earned with the grove keepers.
